summary: Iteration 226 - Batch 14 (AI Predictions: Cancellation Risk Scoring + Upsell Propensity Scoring) tested. Backend: 15/15 tests passed. Frontend: All features working. AI Predictions Panel accessible via sidebar '✨ AI Tahminler (Risk + Upsell)'. Cancel Risk tab shows 4 KPIs (Yüksek/Orta/Düşük risk + Risk altındaki gelir), filter controls (days/min_score), booking rows with scores (0-100) and band labels. Detail drawer opens on row click showing signals with +/- impact. Upsell tab shows 5 category KPI cards (Oda Upgrade, Geç Çıkış, Kahvaltı, SPA, Transfer), category filter dropdown, rows with per-category scores. Save-offer and send-offer APIs working (MOCKED email delivery). Regression smoke passed for Today Hub, Command Palette, TR Compliance.

issues: With min_score=50 and default bookings, no upsell rows appear - this is expected behavior as bookings don't have high enough propensity scores. Lower min_score to 40 to see results.

critical_code_review_comments: Cancel risk scoring uses baseline 30 + signal impacts, clamped to 0-100. Signals include: lead_time, days_to_arrival, channel (OTA vs direct), payment_status, modification_count, price_deviation, guest_loyalty, VIP tags
Upsell propensity scores 5 categories independently: room_upgrade, late_checkout, breakfast, spa, transport. Factors: channel, occasion, loyalty_tier, lifetime_revenue, room_type, stay_length
Save-offer creates voucher STAY-{booking_id[:6]} with 10% discount, queued status. Updates booking.save_offer_sent_at and inserts to save_offers collection
Upsell send-offer creates offer UP-{booking_id[:6]}-{category[:3]} with queued status. Validates category against allowed set
Email delivery is MOCKED (RESEND_API_KEY not configured for real dispatch) - offers are queued only
All AI prediction endpoints require admin/manager/receptionist role (auth enforced)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing default property with bookings
